keys.FIDELITY_HEADLINE: core fields stay within frozen RMSE limits through 24 hours
keys.CPU_ENERGY_METHOD: uses approximately200W on twelve cores (maintainer measurement); GPU host CPU energy is outside the board-power comparison
keys.LICENSE_LINE: See [LICENSE_NOTES.md](LICENSE_NOTES.md) for attribution and licensing information.
keys.EXTENDED_LEAD_DISCLOSURE: Beyond 24 h, the complete six-case predecessor (`1fece48da`) exceeds limits on the 1 km domain: 0227 U10/V10 from +41 h, V at +67 h, W at +69–70 h and RAINNC at +67–72 h; 0120 U10 at +58 h. The scored v0.3.0 0227 case agrees with that displaced wake/convection pattern. [Exact hours and signed biases](docs/release/VALIDATION.md) preserve every failure.
